# Eidova

> Open-source design systems, React components, guidance and UI review tools for coding agents.

## Connect

- [Full MCP](https://eidova-mcp.vercel.app/mcp): Streamable HTTP; 42 public tools. Use an MCP client, not a browser GET.
- [Core MCP](https://eidova-mcp.vercel.app/mcp/core): 13 read-only essentials. Reconnect after switching profiles.
- [Server metadata](https://eidova.vercel.app/server.json): MCP Registry-format metadata; npm and Registry publication remain deferred.

## Agent and client setup

- [AGENTS.md starter](https://eidova.vercel.app/AGENTS.md): Review and merge into existing project instructions. Does not configure the connection.
- [Codex configuration](https://eidova.vercel.app/mcp-config/codex.toml)
- [Claude Code configuration](https://eidova.vercel.app/mcp-config/claude-code.json)
- [Cursor configuration](https://eidova.vercel.app/mcp-config/cursor.json)
- [VS Code configuration](https://eidova.vercel.app/mcp-config/vscode.json)
- [Setup reference](https://github.com/pranav256/eidova-mcp/blob/main/docs/AGENT-SETUP.md)
- [Client compatibility and stdio setup](https://github.com/pranav256/eidova-mcp/blob/main/docs/CLIENTS.md)

## Product and reference

- [Documentation](https://eidova.vercel.app/docs)
- [Resources](https://eidova.vercel.app/resources): 784 packages; preserve original licenses.
- [Showcase](https://eidova.vercel.app/showcase)
- [API reference](https://github.com/pranav256/eidova-mcp/blob/main/docs/API.md)
- [Runtime boundaries](https://github.com/pranav256/eidova-mcp/blob/main/docs/RUNTIME-BOUNDARIES.md)
- [Security](https://github.com/pranav256/eidova-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

Public tools return source, guidance, evidence and commands. They do not execute projects,
perform hosted installation or supply trusted dashboard captures. Public use needs no key.
Private capability keys must never appear in URLs or browser-exposed configuration.
